subject: HSM operator chain-of-custody + rotation log samples (Northbridge due diligence)
messages:
From: Alice Huang <sec@northbridge.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Greer <tom.greer@northbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HSM operator chain-of-custody + rotation logs for SOC2 review

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for taking this. As part of our SOC 2 due diligence for the fund, we need the following from Redwood for the last 6 months:

- Operator roster and operator role matrix for HSM access (who performed key ceremonies, who had operator accounts).
- Shift/operation logs showing physical/operator sessions against HSMs (UTC timestamps OK).
- Key rotation schedule and a representative rotation log sample for tenant keys (not raw key material).
- A signed attestation that HSM operators follow dual-control procedures during ceremonies.

Would you be able to share a zipped evidence bundle or a Drive link with redacted PII by end of next week? Also specify any retention/archival policy for those logs.

Regards,
Alice Huang
Security & Risk Analyst
Northbridge Capital
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Huang <sec@northbridge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HSM operator chain-of-custody + rotation logs for SOC2 review

Hi Alice,

Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a curated bundle that preserves operator IDs (pseudonymized if needed), rotation metadata, and a signed attestation. To confirm scope: you want 6 months of operator/shift logs and one representative rotation sequence per tenant (we'll include the sequence of events and metadata, not the key material).

Internal owners: Marissa will package the logs and the operator matrix, Ben will attach the rotation samples and retention policy, and I'll sign the attestation. Irene (cc'd) can help with additional redaction if Northbridge needs it.

Timeline: we'll aim to share an encrypted Drive folder by 2027-06-07 EOD Pacific. If you need it sooner for the audit window, say so and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Security Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Alice Huang <sec@northbridge.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 13:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HSM operator chain-of-custody + rotation logs for SOC2 review

On Thu, Jun 4, 2027 at 10:07 AM karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the clear list. We'll assemble a curated bundle that preserves operator IDs (pseudonymized if needed), rotation metadata, and a signed attestation.

Hi Alice / team,

Attached is the first pass of materials we'll drop to Drive:
- hsm-operator-matrix.pdf (operator roles, last 6 months; operator IDs pseudonymized to OP-###)
- rotation-logs_sample.csv (one representative rotation sequence per tenant, timestamps + actor IDs + event hash)
- retention-policy.txt (excerpt with retention windows and archival procedures)

Notes / caveats:
- The rotation-logs_sample.csv contains only metadata (no key material or unwrapped key data).
- Operator session logs were filtered to remove ephemeral IPs and MFA tokens; we preserved UTC timestamps and event hashes to allow your verification.
- For audit traceability, we included the HSM firmware and cluster identifiers in the appendix. If you require a deeper telemetry dump (e.g., raw shift logs), please indicate which tenant(s) you need so we can run an export with the appropriate consent.

I'll upload to a shared encrypted Drive folder and paste a link once uploaded; Ben will add the formal retention excerpt.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: hsm-operator-matrix.pdf (application/pdf), rotation-logs_sample.csv (text/csv), retention-policy.txt (text/plain)
From: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Huang <sec@northbridge.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -07:00

Marissa, Karthik, Alice —

Uploaded the bundle to an encrypted Drive folder. Link and access granted to sec@northbridge.com. Files in the folder:
- rotation-logs_sample.csv (CSV with columns: tenant_id, rotation_id, event_ts_utc, operator_id, event_type, event_hash)
- hsm-operator-matrix.pdf
- signed-attestation-northbridge.pdf (Karthik signature present)
- retention-policy.txt

Small snippet from rotation-logs_sample.csv (sanitized):

tenant_123, rot-20270102-01, 2027-01-02T03:12:18Z, OP-007, key_wrap, ab12cd34ef
tenant_456, rot-20270310-02, 2027-03-10T22:05:40Z, OP-002, key_deactivate, 98fe7b61a4

Drive link (access granted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEXAMPLE

From: Alice Huang <sec@northbridge.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HSM operator chain-of-custody + rotation logs for SOC2 review

Thanks — we received the Drive invite and the sample bundle. Quick clarifications:

1) For the rotation samples, can you confirm whether the event_hash is HMAC-SHA256 over the event metadata (we want to validate integrity but not see raw material).
2) For operator IDs (OP-###) is there a separate mapping available under an NDA that maps to employee IDs for our auditor?

If you can reply to those two points in the same folder (as a short readme), we can close this control in our SOC2 matrix and proceed to a short call next week if needed.

Regards,
Alice Huang
Security & Risk Analyst
Northbridge Capital
